name: proxy_openai_authed_no_api_key
description:
OpenAI proxy with valid Bearer but no OPENAI_API_KEY configured in the workspace. Current behavior: 503 with a specific error message pointing users to Settings → Environments. Refactor must preserve this exact 503 contract — a workspace with an agent token but no upstream key is a real onboarding state that must fail loudly.

Future fixture (proxy_openai_authed_with_key) will seed OPENAI_API_KEY on the workspace + mock upstream to test the 200 success path.
